verdict.rationale: Salesforce's own Agentforce layer brings agents into Sales Cloud across the deal cycle, with examples like updating opportunities and qualifying leads. Agent Builder explicitly accepts natural language, though for building agents rather than for issuing everyday commands. The evidence shows agents and natural-language agent building, but never shows a user directly operating CRM records by conversational command. Missing for 10: documented natural-language command interface for end users (e.g., chat-driven record updates or queries), hands-on or independent corroboration, detail on which Sales Cloud actions are reachable by natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
